hosting._noPredeploy: There is deliberately NO predeploy hook. Firebase runs predeploy for `hosting:channel:deploy` as well as a live deploy, so a hook that runs the production build silently overwrites a staging (test-database) build seconds before upload — which shipped a preview URL wired to REAL data. Build and deploy are paired in web/package.json instead: `npm run deploy:staging` and `npm run deploy:live`.
hosting._headerOrder: Rules are applied in order and the LAST match wins per header key. The catch-all must therefore come FIRST and /assets/** last, or the immutable asset caching is overwritten by the no-cache rule. Note the catch-all also has to carry Cache-Control: every route is served by the SPA rewrite as index.html, so a rule matching the literal /index.html never fires — the request path is /, or /{companyId}/payroll. Getting that wrong pins a stale index.html in browser caches for an hour after each deploy.
